request: how do you turn 3/8 into a decimal?

beats.intent: A bar cut into 8 equal parts with 3 shaded
beats.narration: Three eighths: cut a bar into eight equal parts and shade three.
beats.code:
stage.title("3/8 as a decimal")
bar = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=1.1, height=0.8, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.6 if k < 3 else 0.1, fill_color=BLUE) for k in range(8)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0).move_to([0, 1.2, 0])
stage.play(Create(bar))
stage.add(bar)
stage.label(bar, "3 of 8 parts", direction=UP)

beats.intent: A number line from 0 to 1 below it with 0.375 marked under the end of the shading
beats.narration: Each eighth is one divided by eight, nought point one two five. Three of them reach nought point three seven five.
beats.code:
nl = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 1, 0.125], length=8.8, include_numbers=False).move_to([0, -0.6, 0])
stage.play(Create(nl))
stage.add(nl)
for v in (0, 0.5, 1):
    stage.add(Text(str(v), font_size=24).next_to(nl.n2p(v), DOWN, buff=0.2))
p = mark_point(stage, nl, 0.375, color=YELLOW, label="0.375")

beats.narration: So three eighths is three divided by eight: nought point three seven five.

beats.intent: A number line from 2.4 to 2.5 with 2.47 marked
beats.narration: Two point four seven sits between two point four and two point five.
beats.code:
stage.title("Rounding 2.47")
nl = draw_number_line(stage, x_range=(2.4, 2.5))
x = mark_point(stage, nl, 2.47, color=YELLOW, label="2.47")

beats.intent: The halfway point 2.45 marked and the distances to each end: 0.07 back, 0.03 forward
beats.narration: The halfway point is two point four five. Two point four seven is past it: only three hundredths from two point five.
beats.code:
half = mark_point(stage, nl, 2.45, color=GREY_B, label="halfway")
fwd = Line(nl.n2p(2.47) + 0.5 * UP, nl.n2p(2.5) + 0.5 * UP, color=GREEN, stroke_width=6)
stage.play(Create(fwd))
stage.add(fwd)
stage.label(fwd, "0.03", direction=UP, color=GREEN)

beats.narration: So it rounds up, to two point five.
beats.code:
arr = Arrow(nl.n2p(2.47) + 1.1 * UP, nl.n2p(2.5) + 1.1 * UP, buff=0, color=YELLOW)
stage.play(GrowArrow(arr))
stage.add(arr)
stage.equation(r"2.47 \approx 2.5")

request: if it's 3 degrees and the temperature drops 8 degrees, what is it?

beats.intent: A vertical thermometer scale from -10 to 10 with a marker at 3
beats.narration: A thermometer is a number line standing up. It reads three degrees.
beats.code:
stage.title("Below zero")
scale = NumberLine(x_range=[-10, 10, 1], length=5.6, rotation=PI / 2, include_numbers=False).move_to([-1, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(Create(scale))
stage.add(scale)
for v in (-10, -5, 0, 5, 10):
    stage.add(Text(str(v), font_size=22).next_to(scale.n2p(v), LEFT, buff=0.25))
zero = Line(scale.n2p(0) + 0.4 * LEFT, scale.n2p(0) + 0.4 * RIGHT, color=BLUE, stroke_width=5)
stage.add(zero)
level = Dot(scale.n2p(3), color=RED, radius=0.14)
stage.play(GrowFromCenter(level))
stage.add(level)
stage.label(scale.n2p(3) + 0.15 * RIGHT, "3°", direction=RIGHT, color=RED)

beats.intent: The marker sliding down 8 steps, past 0, to -5
beats.narration: Drop eight degrees: three steps to zero, then five more below it.
beats.code:
stage.play(level.animate.move_to(scale.n2p(-5)), run_time=2)
drop = Arrow(scale.n2p(3) + 0.9 * RIGHT, scale.n2p(-5) + 0.9 * RIGHT, buff=0, color=YELLOW)
stage.play(GrowArrow(drop))
stage.add(drop)
stage.label(drop, "−8", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)
stage.label(scale.n2p(-5) + 0.2 * DOWN, "−5°", direction=DOWN, color=RED)

beats.narration: Three minus eight is minus five: five degrees below zero.

beats.intent: 12 dots arranged as a 3 by 4 rectangle and as a 2 by 6 rectangle
beats.narration: Twelve dots can be arranged into rectangles: three by four, or two by six.
beats.code:
stage.title("What makes a prime")
r1 = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.12, color=BLUE) for _ in range(12)]).arrange_in_grid(rows=3, cols=4, buff=0.3).move_to([-3.2, 0.3, 0])
r2 = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.12, color=BLUE) for _ in range(12)]).arrange_in_grid(rows=2, cols=6, buff=0.3).move_to([2.4, 0.3, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(r1), FadeIn(r2))
stage.add(r1, r2)
stage.label(r1, "3 × 4", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)
stage.label(r2, "2 × 6", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: 7 dots that only make a single row
beats.narration: Seven dots won't make any rectangle except one long row.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
row = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.12, color=YELLOW) for _ in range(7)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3).move_to([0, 0.3, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(row))
stage.add(row)
stage.label(row, "only 1 × 7", direction=DOWN, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: The row beside: 7 = 1 × 7 only, so 7 is prime
beats.narration: A number whose only rectangle is a single row, with exactly two factors, one and itself, is prime.
